items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: And he liked to get in there with us, you know, he'd take the bass

ctx.x: You really had that job. Oh yeah, we had.

We had that job every Saturday and holidays. Every Saturday and holidays. And she had a good place. All them jurors just come from out there and they tip us great. Five, ten dollars, fifteen, twenty. Captain DeLatchy used to come out there. He wanted to give us a hundred dollar bill, his wife snatched it out of my hand. He don't know what he's doing, give me this money back. And he was a bass player himself, Captain DeLatchy, you might know him. No, I don't know him. He was on the 40s floor. Yeah, I don't know.…
I was going to ask a little bit before we've only got a couple more minutes to start on here, but anything about your lessons you can remember that old man up is Jim Humphrey
